name: Ivorian Grilled Chicken
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 tbsp chile powder or 20 fresh puréed red habanero chillies

steps: Combine the garlic, pepper, chili powder, mustard, and bouillon cubes. Pour the mixture over the chicken and massage it very well. Let rest for about 20 minutes while you prepare the grill.
Place the chicken on the grill, turning it regularly until each piece become golden brown.
When it is done to your taste, serve with any complimentary side such as Ivorian tomato sauce or Ivorian salad and enjoy.
